name: Pluspoint
oneLiner: London-based reputation and local marketing platform for multi-location businesses: review collection and replies, listings management, surveys, messaging campaigns and social posting, priced per location.
bestFor: Multi-location restaurant groups and franchises, including in Europe, that want reviews, listings and local SEO in one tool at a published per-location price.

updates.text: Pluspoint made its MCP connector generally available, letting Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and other assistants read reviews, audit listings and queue review requests (month estimated from the post's age; social posting via MCP announced as coming soon).

features: Review requests by SMS, email, WhatsApp and QR codes
Central inbox for reviews from Google, Facebook and other sites with AI reply suggestions
Listings management for Google and Facebook, with an add-on to sync to 200+ directories such as Apple Maps, Bing, Yelp and TripAdvisor
Messaging campaigns and AI-generated social posts for Google, Facebook and Instagram
Per-location analytics, sentiment and keyword analysis
MCP connector for working with reviews and listings from AI assistants

pricing.text: $29 per location per month with every feature included (about $24.17 billed annually); minimum 3 locations; 3 users and 50 AI credits included (extra users $19, extra credits $0.49); Listings Sync add-on $39 per location per month; 14-day free trial; custom plan above 30 locations or users.

notes: The current review says 'Custom pricing'; Pluspoint now publishes $29/location (older blog posts list $39 Starter / $69 Professional, now outdated). Founded 2021 by Ukrainian founders, HQ London, $400K seed in September 2023 (Pragmatech Ventures); no later funding found. Case-study results (e.g. Starfoods rating 2.8 to 4.8) are vendor-published. The current review's 'users highlight measurable revenue' line is unverified (very few third-party reviews). Prices from search snippets of pluspoint.io/pricing (site not fetchable); what Listings Sync covers at no cost conflicts slightly between pages.
